entries.question: framework self-audit で次に残る gap は何か
entries.answer: Executable pre-implementation review schemas, example packages, verifier rules, and pilot evidence remain future work.
entries.expectation_state: The release slice updates QIF to v0.3.1 as a docs-only pre-implementation review and done-before quality gate milestone with package metadata, changelog, release notes, Council review evidence, and verification.
entries.mismatch_state: Executable pre-implementation review schemas, example packages, verifier rules, and pilot evidence remain future work.
entries.scale_direction: Publish v0.3.1 and use a later slice for executable pre-implementation review records and verifier rules.

entries.question: framework self-audit で次に残る gap は何か
entries.answer: Complete rule-by-rule fixture coverage is still open for qif-package, expert-judgment, and runtime package surfaces other than quality-gate.
entries.expectation_state: The implementation generalized the retained fixture runner and added selected qif-package and expert-judgment negative fixture corpora while preserving the quality-gate corpus.
entries.mismatch_state: Complete rule-by-rule fixture coverage is still open for qif-package, expert-judgment, and runtime package surfaces other than quality-gate.
entries.scale_direction: Use a follow-on v0.4.x slice to extend complete retained negative coverage to the remaining verifier surfaces.

entries.question: まだ解くべき問題は同じか
entries.answer: はい。v0.4.1では最初の非quality-gate fixture拡張を完了し、次は完全な非quality-gate verifier fixture coverageを広げる。
entries.expectation_state: v0.4.1 is a hardening slice, not a concept redesign.
entries.mismatch_state: Complete fixture coverage remains open for several verifier surfaces.
entries.scale_direction: Use the next v0.4.x slice for complete retained negative coverage expansion.
